board.summary: Bad Left Hook's Aug. 29 fight-week slate remains the actionable pool, and today's fresh Cameron interview strengthens her matchup thesis without creating a price edge. No PLAY is live. Cameron ML remains a B-grade WAIT at +240 or better versus best +220. The method-market hold pushes Cameron by decision to a stricter +500 entry. Hrgovic remains a WATCH, but a mature market and broad expert support for Itauma raise the useful trigger to +800. Berinchyk stays price-sensitive at +500 or better. Martinez's straight moneyline remains overtaxed and no defensible KO/TKO quote was verified. Event start metadata was refreshed to published card/event starts in Pacific time.

cards.movement: BEST MARKET STILL +220 · TARGET NOT REACHED
cards.rationale: Bad Left Hook's fresh fight-week interview adds confidence in Cameron's preparation, but the market still prices Mayer as a clear favorite. Best three-way prices normalize Cameron to about 29.4%, roughly +240 fair, while an independent current projection also places her near the low-30% range. The thesis survives, but +220 does not leave enough margin.

cards.market: MAYER vs CAMERON · METHOD OF VICTORY
cards.movement: METHOD PRICE +370 · HOLD-ADJUSTED FAIR ~+458 · ENTRY TIGHTENED
cards.rationale: The ten-round, two-minute-round format and both fighters' decision-heavy profiles keep the method viable, but the full method market carries substantial hold. Normalizing the available outcomes puts Cameron by decision near +458 fair, so the prior +450 trigger is too thin. Require +500 or better for a real cushion.

cards.movement: BEST MARKET +700 · BROAD CONSENSUS STILL FAVORS ITAUMA
cards.rationale: Bad Left Hook's upset case remains Hrgovic's size, experience and ability to test dimensions Itauma has not yet had to prove, but fight-week expert consensus heavily favors Itauma. The best current three-way market normalizes Hrgovic near +722 fair. +750 offers too little separation for this longshot profile, so the useful trigger moves to +800 or better.

Best three-way prices normalize him around +479 fair, making +450 effectively market price rather than value. Keep +500 as the minimum re-entry level.
